title: Blush Framework icon pack manifest
description: An icon pack's icons.json: its name, label, namespace, and the folder its SVG icons are in.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema editors check this file with.

name.description: The icon pack's name, the key it's known by: vendor/name, such as "acme/gallery". Its folder is extensions/{vendor}/{name}, so it must match the folder. Without it, the name in the composer.json beside this file is used; for a Composer package, it's the package name.

label.description: The icon pack's title, as people read it. Without one, it's shown by its name.

namespace.description: The namespace the icon pack's components, icons, and translations go by, such as "gallery" for gallery/slideshow. No two installed extensions may share one. Without one, it's the name with hyphens for the "/" and any ".", such as "acme-gallery".

folder.description: The folder inside the pack its *.svg files are in, such as "svg". Defaults to the pack's own folder. Each {icon}.svg is {namespace}/{icon}.

require.description: What the pack needs, as composer.json says it, with version constraints: php, blush-dev/framework for Blush, ext-{name} for PHP extensions, and other plugins, themes, or icon packs by vendor/name. A pack whose requirements aren't met doesn't load. Without it, a pack in extensions/ uses the require in the composer.json beside this file.

authors.description: Who made the icon pack, as composer.json lists authors. Without it, the authors in the composer.json beside this file are used.

role.description: What they did, such as "Developer" or "Designer".

license.description: How the icon pack may be used: an SPDX identifier such as "MIT", a list of them any of which applies, "(MIT or Apache-2.0)", "(MIT and OFL-1.1)" when all apply, or "proprietary". Common open source licenses link to their text in the admin. Without it, the license in the composer.json beside this file is used.

homepage.description: The icon pack's website. Without it, the homepage in the composer.json beside this file is used.

support.description: Where to get help with the icon pack, as composer.json has it. Without it, the support in the composer.json beside this file is used.

source.description: Where to browse or download the source.

irc.description: An IRC channel, such as irc://irc.libera.chat/example.

security.description: How to report a security issue.

funding.description: Where to fund the icon pack, as composer.json has it. Without it, the funding in the composer.json beside this file is used.

type.description: The kind of funding, such as github, patreon, opencollective, tidelift, ko-fi, or custom.
